# Examples

This topic provides practical examples for common tfctl operations. Use these examples as starting points for your own workflows.

## Start a new workspace run

1. Start a new run using the [`tfctl run start`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/run/start) command:

   ```shell-session
   $ tfctl run start example-app-workspace --message="Run started with tfctl."
   ```

   The command creates a new run and displays the run ID.

1. Monitor the run status using the [`tfctl run status`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/run/status) command. Replace `<RUN_ID>` with the run ID output from the previous command.

   ```shell-session
   $ tfctl run status <RUN_ID>
   ```

## Import workspace variables from a file

Import variables into your workspace from a file.

1. Create a [Terraform variable definition file](/terraform/language/values/variables#variable-definition-files) in HCL or JSON format with your variable definitions.

1. Import the variables using the [`tfctl variable import`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/variable/import) command:

   ```shell-session
   $ tfctl variable import --file variables.hcl
   ```

## Configure profiles

This example demonstrates how to use profiles to manage multiple workspace contexts.

```shell-session
# Set profile for production workspace
$ tfctl profile set organization my-org
$ tfctl profile set workspace production

# Display current profile
$ tfctl profile display

# Switch to staging workspace
$ tfctl profile set workspace staging

# Verify the change
$ tfctl profile get workspace
```

## Use API commands

This example shows how to use tfctl to interact with the HCP Terraform API directly.

```shell-session
# Get workspace details
$ tfctl api get workspaces/ws-abc123

# Create a new workspace
$ tfctl api create workspaces \
  --data '{"data":{"type":"workspaces","attributes":{"name":"new-workspace"}}}'
```

## Configure multiple profiles

Configure profiles for EU and US organizations, and authenticate to both. You must already have users with access to the organizations in each HCP Terraform instance.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles create us --hostname=app.terraform.io
$ tfctl profile set default_organization my-us-org-name
$ tfctl auth login # Create API token in web browser, copy it, then paste it to terminal

$ tfctl profile profiles create eu --hostname=app.eu.terraform.io
$ tfctl profile set default_organization my-eu-org-name
$ tfctl auth login # Create API token in web browser, copy it, then paste it to terminal

$ tfctl profile profiles activate us # Switch back to us profile
```

## Make HCP Terraform API calls

Use the `api` command to make HCP Terraform API calls.

```shell-session
# Get workspace configuration. Workspace must already exist in this org.
$ tfctl api /organizations/{organization}/workspaces/example-app-workspace
```
